ted images and local persistence.
# Quick Notes (`dsh-quick-notes`)

A floating sticky-note pad for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web GUI. Keep a few
short notes in a small

window above your session — ideas, to-dos, a phone number,
something you need to remember — and the
plugin saves them for you automatically.
English · 简体中文
## What it is for

While you work in DSH, you often need a scratchpad that stays visible without
taking over the screen

. Quick Notes puts a movable note window over the
interface. You can keep several notes in a list, s

witch between them, and close
or minimize the window whenever you want. The notes are saved on your

computer,
so they are still there after a page refresh or a DSH restart.
Typical uses:

- write down an idea or a question before it slips away;
- keep a short to-do list next to the conve
nformation (a command, an address, a draft reply).
## Features

- **Several notes in one place** — a directory on the left, the current note on
the right; create, r

ename, pin, delete and drag to reorder.
- **Recycle bin** — deleted notes are kept for a while and c

an be restored, so a
mis-click is not the end of the world.
- **Simple text editing** — bold, italic

and underline, plus copy, cut, paste and
clear formatting from the right-click menu.
- **Pictures**

— paste or drag a screenshot into a note; it is scaled down
automatically so it fits the window.
-

**A window that stays out of the way** — move it by the title bar, resize it,
switch to notes-only m

ode, or shrink it to a small floating ball.
- **Size and position are remembered** — including a “re

set to default size” and
“reset to default position” action.
- **Settings** — font size, line height

, light / dark / follow-system theme, ruled
paper, and JSON export / import for backups.
- **English
and Chinese interface** — the UI follows the DSH language.
## Screenshots

Screenshots are taken from the released 1.0.0 build. See
`assets/README.md`
for how they are produce

e taken from the released 1.0.0 build. See
`assets/README.md`
for how they are produced and updated.
## Installation

Quick Notes needs **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0 or newer**. Node.js **22.13 or newer** is
what the plugin

's local data service expects; DSH ships its own Node runtime, so you
only need Node on your machine
when building from source.
### From the DSH UI

1. Open the **Plugins** page in the DSH sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin → Install a third-party plugi

n**, enter `dsh-quick-notes`
and confirm.
3. Restart DSH once if the plugin does not appear immediat

ely, then open the
notes window from the notes icon at the bottom of the left sidebar.

If you use a plugin market — the built-in **Plugins → Discover** tab with an
index source configured

, or the community dshmarket plugin under
**Settings → Plugin market** — you can also search for **Q

uick Notes** (or
**随想随记**) there and install it.
### With the command line

`web` is the profile name the DSH Web UI uses; replace it with your own profile
name when you use a

different one. If the written window does not appear, restart
DSH so the local data service can star

fferent one. If the written window does not appear, restart
DSH so the local data service can start.
### From a local checkout (development)
[代码示例省略，未执行]

You can also point DSH at the folder from the **Plugins** page →
**Add plugin → Install a third-part

y plugin** and select the directory that
contains `package.json`.
## Getting started

1. Click the notes icon at the bottom of the left sidebar. The note window opens.
2. Press `+` in th

e directory to create a note, type a name, and press `Enter`.
3. Type in the note body. There is no

save button; changes are written
automatically after you pause for a moment.
4. Add more notes whene

ver you need them, and click a note in the directory to
switch to it.
### Working with notes

- Double-click a note name in the directory to rename it.
- Double-click the title above the editor

to rename the current note in place.
- Use the pin button on a row to keep an important note at the

top.
- Drag rows up or down to change the order, or press `Alt` + `↑` / `↓` while a row
is focused.

- Deleting a note sends it to the recycle bin; the bin can restore it or delete it
permanently.
### Formatting
Select some text and right-click inside the editor. The menu contains:
| Action           | What it does                                           |

| Copy             | Copy the selection to the system clipboard             |
| Cut              | C

opy the selection and remove it                       |
| Paste            | Insert the clipboard co

ntent at the caret              |
| Clear formatting | Remove bold / italic / underline and pasted f

e caret              |
| Clear formatting | Remove bold / italic / underline and pasted formatting |

On the keyboard, `Ctrl`/`Cmd` + `B`, `I` and `U` toggle bold, italic and
underline. `Ctrl`/`Cmd` + `
V` pastes plain text or cleaned HTML.
[该节后续省略]
## Data and privacy

- Notes are stored locally at `~/.dsh/quick-notes/notes.json`
(`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\quick-notes\notes

.json` on Windows). If `DSH_HOME` is
set, the file lives under that directory instead.
- You can mov

e the data directory with the `DSH_QUICK_NOTES_DIR` environment
variable.
- The browser keeps a loca

l copy so the window keeps working if the local data
service is briefly unavailable. The file is the

shared copy; the browser copy
is a fallback.
- **The plugin does not upload anything.** Note conten

t is not sent to any
server; there is no account and no telemetry. The data file is plain JSON, so
u

se disk encryption if the notes are sensitive.
- You can back up your notes with **Settings → Export

JSON** or by copying
`notes.json` while DSH is closed.
## Compatibility
| Component        | Requirement                           |

| DeepSeek Harness | 0.2.0 or newer                        |
| Node.js          | 22.13 or newer (DS

H runtime / builds) |
| DSH surface      | DSH Desktop / DSH Web GUI             |
| Data format
| `schemaVersion: 1`                    |
